stories.title: Barracuda links cloud breach to ARTEX AI-powered cyberattack
stories.summary: Hackers who breached the cloud environment of network and email security company Barracuda earlier this month used a stolen cloud access key and the ARTEX AI penetration testing framework.

stories.title: Microsoft says months-old bug caused global Microsoft 365 outage
stories.summary: Microsoft says a software bug introduced in July caused last week's worldwide Microsoft 365 outage, triggering a cascading failure that left more than 80% of its networking gateway servers unresponsive.

entries.title: The leak didn't move the date
entries.body: Rockstar ran its Netflix Extended Look on 27 August as planned, and 19 November still stands. Take-Two, meanwhile, has served DMCA subpoenas on Microsoft, Discord, X and Google chasing the handle CyberLeek.
